t: Nistam beshabbat petach o challon bemaqom sheereb bo
s: Nistam beshabbat petach o challon bemaqom sheereb bo ubo d' seipim: b' battim o b' chatzerot sheerebu yachad al yede shehaya benehem challon o petach, venistam beshabbat — muttarim lehishtammesh mizzeh lezeh derek gobah kotel vechorayv, sheshshabbat kevan shehuttera — huttera. Abal im nistam mibbeod yom, apillu chazar veniptach beshabbat — asurim, lepi sheadayin lo qanu erub meolam, sheqqeniyyat haerub hu ben hashshemashot, vekan lo haya erub ben hashshemashot kevan shehappetach satum, umishshechasheka lo qanu erub, sheen meorbin mishshettechshak. Vaapillu erebu kebar lipne shabbat sheobra, veoto erub nishar adayin qayyam — enan yekolim lismok alayv beshabbat zo achar shenniptach happetach, hoil ukebar nitbattel mibbeod yom veeno chozer veneor mishshettechshak. Abal im mittechilla erebu leshabbatot harbeh, apillu erebu leshana o yoter, veqanu erub beben hashshemashot shel shabbat rishona, shehaya happetach patuach veachar kak nistam happetach veniptach beshabbat acheret, apillu besop hashshana — chozer haerub veneor, vaapillu setamo bemezid. Veyesh mi shechoshesh lehachamir im setamo bemezid, hoil vegilla dato bistima zo sheeno chapetz baerub — eno chozer veneur keshenniptach. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Haya kotel ben [shette] chatzerot, veereba kol achat leatzmah, venipratz hakkotel beshabbat — muttarim letaltel kol echad bachatzero ad meqom hakkotel apillu kelim sheshshabetu babbayit, sheshshabbat kevan shehuttera — huttera. Abal chatzer shennipretza beshabbat lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit pirtza haosartah — en omerim "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b:

Chatzer qetanna shennipretza mibbeod yom bemilluah ligdola, veen bappirtza yoter meeser ammot — gedola mutteret lehotzi kelim sheshshabetu babbayit lachatzerah im ereba leatzmah, veap al pi shello ereba im haqqetanna, en haqqetanna oseret aleha, mippene sheppirtza zo hi laggedola kepetach sheen lah bemilluah, ella nishtayyeru bah gippupim odepim al pirtzat haqqetanna mikkan umikkan. Vehaqqetanna asura lehotzi kelim sheshshabetu babbayit lachatzera, hoil venipretza bemilluah lehaggedola, ella im ken ereba im haggedola. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshenniknasin kotle orek haqqetanna letok haggedola umuplagin sham g' tepachim mikkotle orek haggedola, sheim lo ken ap haqqetanna nitteret al yede gippupe haggedola, mishshum nireh mibbechutz veshaveh mibbipnim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"s:

Veken gag qatan hammuqqap maaqeh sebibo geboha alayv asara shennipratz sham bemilluo legag gadol hammuqqap gam ken kamohu, velo erebu habbattim yachad — qatan asur lehaalot alayv kelim sheshshabetu babbayit im mechitztzotayv niknasot letok haggadol, hoil veen lo mechitztza lehapsiq beno laggadol shello ereb immo, vegadol muttar, mippene sheyyesh lo gippupim odepim al pirtzat haqqatan. Veken apillu im enan muqqapim maaqeh kelal, ella shemmechitztzot habbayit sabib nikkarot venirot lemi sheomed al sepat haggag keshemmistakkel tachat raglayv, sheaz omerim bahen "gud asseq" ukeillu hen omedot lemala al sepat haggag, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h. Abal mechitztzot habbayit shebben qatan laggadol en omerim bah "gud asseq", hoil veenah niret lemi sheomed sham milmala, shehare haggaggin mechubbarin zeh lezeh umekassim al pirtzat haqqetanna veen roim otah, umeqom mechitztza zo lemala hi kepirtza bemilluah mehaqqatan lehaggadol, ulehaggadol enah bemilluo, shehare kotel bayit haggadol odep mikkan umikkan venireh lemi sheomed al sepat haggag. Ulepikak gadol muttar veqatan asur im niknasim kotle beto letok haggadol. Abal im gam mechitztzot habbayit sabib enan nikkarot venirot lemi sheomed al sepat haggag, kegon shehaggag bolet alehen — karmelit hu, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h, ella im ken challon d' al d' patuach lo mehabbayit (veaz hu reshut hayyachid kemo shennitbaer sham). Abal mikkol maqom im lo erebu yachad ap haggadol asur bekelim sheshshabetu babbayit, lepi sheen lo gippupim odepim mikkan umikkan, shehare kotel habbayit en omerim bo "gud asseq", hoil veeno nikkar lemi sheomed lemala:
